content:
Nostr is very decentralized if you post text. I regularly post to nearly 100 servers around the world.

If however you post an image, meme, video or other blob, #nostr is hardly decentralized at all. What is the point of posting an important meme to 100 geographically different relays, if an attacker only has to take down one link to your meme?

This is where blossom servers and BUD-10 come in. Unfortunately most nostr clients today don't support BUD-10. The good news is, it has never been easier to implement. Just whisper it to your agent, and it can be quickly done.

Here is a long form note I am going to maintain to try to encourage developers to implement BUD-10. BUD-10 in my opinion is the most important technology missing from our stack.
